shape_rules: Chassis must be a rounded rectangle with beveled edges.
Top panel is a shallow metallic silver flat surface centered on the chassis.
Status dome is a small hemispherical shape made of blue-glass, positioned centrally on top of the chassis.
Four arms are identical in length and thickness, radiating outward at 90-degree intervals from the chassis center.
Each arm has a small silver collar at its inner connection point to the chassis.
At the outer end of each arm is a flat horizontal circular torus rotor guard larger than the arm diameter.
Inside each guard, there must be a central hub and three thin tapered propeller blades.
The U-shaped bracket under the chassis is made of brushed steel, facing downward, and wider than the camera module.
